name: Scramble Text
description: A GSAP scramble text effect: a band of random glyphs runs ahead of the text and resolves it left to right. Plays on load, on scroll or on hover, without the text ever changing size.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the whole text to resolve.

props.name: spread
props.description: Share of the text scrambling at once, ahead of the resolved part.

props.name: trigger
props.description: 'view' plays once in view, 'mount' right away, 'hover' only when hovered (the text shows normally until then).

props.name: replayOnHover
props.description: Replay whenever the pointer enters, after the first play.

props.name: start
props.description: When 'view' starts, as a ScrollTrigger start.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, if the text sits inside its own scroll container.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the text element. Monospaced fonts scramble without any width wobble.
